query:
SELECT 
  searchId,
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN salesApproachData IS NOT NULL AND salesApproachData != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_approach,
  SUM(CASE WHEN salesApproachData IS NULL OR salesApproachData = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as missing_approach,
  SUM(CASE WHEN salesApproachGeneratedAt IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_timestamp
FROM companies 
WHERE searchId IN (1500002, 1500003)
GROUP BY searchId;
